name: orgforge
description: Resilience engineering for coding-agent teams: a portable governance plane for safe degradation, recovery, evidence-backed adaptation, and human control without replacing Codex.

interface.longDescription: Projects OrgForge's portable governance plane onto Codex so coding-agent teams can sustain acceptable outcomes under variability, degrade or stop safely, recover with explicit revalidation, and adapt from evidence without losing human-held decisions. It uses the existing Codex runtime instead of introducing another agent framework.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use OrgForge governance for this repository: preserve ownership boundaries, follow the declared workflow, require independent checks, and record evidence.
